text:
ConocoPhillips rose 2.3% today to close at $140.75, continuing a sharp two-week rally that has added 12%. Oil prices remain elevated—US crude at $96 and Brent at over $106—supported by ongoing geopolitical tensions including attacks on Saudi infrastructure, a potential Ukraine energy ceasefire violation by Russia, and uncertainty around a proposed Russian diesel deal. The stock has climbed steadily over the past week as crude prices firm amid these supply-side concerns.

The broader context is that oil refiners and producers benefit when crude prices rise and geopolitical risk keeps them elevated. While political debate over the Russian diesel deal suggests uncertainty ahead, the immediate driver is that actual crude prices remain well above $100, and supply disruptions—whether from the Saudi-Houthi conflict, Ukrainian energy infrastructure, or other flashpoints—continue to underpin the energy complex.
